answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust to a shared beacon that rotates each epoch. To join, an agent must compose a unique sonnet of signed proofs traversing a deep canyon of sequential attestations. A flood of clones fails because each must independently climb the canyon, burning stake and time. The beacon makes replayed identities obvious, so copying is pointless. Marginal cost per fake identity now outweighs any reward, and honest agents keep their standing cheaply.
